# Royal Aesthetic & Laser Clinic

> Doctor-supervised medical aesthetics, laser hair reduction, and clinical skincare dispensary in Thana, Malakand, Pakistan.

## About the Clinic
Royal Aesthetic & Laser Clinic provides qualified physician-directed cosmetic dermatology and advanced medical laser procedures in Thana, Malakand, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. The clinic delivers certified, non-surgical aesthetic protocols, pain-free laser technology, and physician-dispensed skincare.

- Canonical URL: https://royalaestheticlaserclinic.netlify.app/
- Physical Location: Pul Chowki, opposite Meeral Restaurant, Thana, Malakand, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/MQF1gR36KicZYmhu5
- Operating Hours: Saturday to Thursday, 11:00 AM – 5:00 PM PKT (Closed Friday)
- WhatsApp Appointment & Consultation: +92 347 9305057
- Direct Booking Link: https://wa.me/923479305057

## Doctor-Supervised Clinical Procedures
- [Laser Hair Reduction](https://royalaestheticlaserclinic.netlify.app/services/laser-hair-reduction): Painless triple-wavelength diode laser with sapphire contact cooling for face, underarms, arms, legs, and full body.
- [HydraFacial Clinical Glow](https://royalaestheticlaserclinic.netlify.app/services/hydrafacial-glow): 7-step medical-grade hydradermabrasion, painless vacuum vortex pore extraction, and peptide hydration.
- [Carbon Laser Peel (Hollywood Peel)](https://royalaestheticlaserclinic.netlify.app/services/carbon-laser-peel): Q-switched Nd:YAG laser exfoliation with liquid carbon lotion for pore tightening and oil control.
- [Acne & Scar Microneedling](https://royalaestheticlaserclinic.netlify.app/services/acne-scar-microneedling): Medical microneedling with targeted growth factors to remodel atrophic acne scars and stimulate collagen.
- [Hair Loss PRP Biotherapy](https://royalaestheticlaserclinic.netlify.app/services/hair-loss-prp): Autologous platelet-rich plasma therapy to strengthen dormant hair follicles and reverse androgenetic thinning.
- [Face PRP Vampire Facial](https://royalaestheticlaserclinic.netlify.app/services/face-prp-vampire-facial): Autologous PRP microneedling for micro-circulation, skin firmness, and natural radiance.
- [Melasma & Pigmentation Toning](https://royalaestheticlaserclinic.netlify.app/services/melasma-pigmentation-toning): Q-switched laser toning targeting dermal melanin without surface downtime.
- [Skin Brightening Micro-Infusion](https://royalaestheticlaserclinic.netlify.app/services/skin-brightening-infusion): Targeted cocktail of glutathione and vitamin C for dull and sun-damaged complexions.
- [Post-Acne Erythema & Redness](https://royalaestheticlaserclinic.netlify.app/services/post-acne-erythema): Calming vascular treatments to heal persistent post-inflammatory erythema (PIE).
- [Fine Lines & Anti-Aging Care](https://royalaestheticlaserclinic.netlify.app/services/anti-aging-wrinkles): Preventative and corrective peptide therapy, botulinum neuromodulation, and skin-tightening care.

- [U-Veil Forte Sunblock SPF 60](https://royalaestheticlaserclinic.netlify.app/product/uveil-forte-sunblock-spf60): 30g non-comedogenic broad-spectrum UVA/UVB cream for daily sun protection (1,450 PKR).
